front.title: Scan to get started
front.instruction: Use your phone camera to open the secure facility registration page. Enter your work email, then create an account or sign in with that exact address.
front.privacy: Safe to post and print: the QR code identifies the facility only. It contains no employee name, email, password, invitation, or permission.

back.title: Your Definian Inspection quick start
back.safety: If the facility shown after scanning is not the location you expected, stop and contact support. No assignment is created until your verified sign-in completes.

steps.title: Install Definian Inspection
steps.detail: Use the iPhone, iPad, or Android installation link on the registration page or in this guide.

steps.title: Create or access your account
steps.detail: Existing users choose Sign in. New users choose Create account and verify the email Auth0 sends.

steps.title: Confirm your assigned facility
steps.detail: Return to the registration page after sign-in and confirm the displayed facility before continuing.

steps.title: Start your first inspection
steps.detail: Open Definian Inspection and sign in with the same verified account. Your facility access loads during sign-in.

steps.title: Get support
steps.detail: Use the support contact below and include the displayed support reference if your access needs attention.
